text_block_list.text:
Though Нарита Брайан's poor health
persists, Hishi
Amazon believes in
her—and doubles down on
her own
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан suffers a crushing defeat at
the
autumn Tenno Sho. The audience is
aghast by
how weak she is now, and
their expectations
begin to fade...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But during an interview before the Japan
Cup,
Hishi Amazon declares to everyone
that her rival
is Нарита Брайан, and Narita
Brian alone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's adamant that her rival will make a

comeback. The conviction rubs off on
the public,
restoring some of their faith.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
